title: Was I in a mall like world?
content: When I found this sub I felt oddly intrigued with what everyone here is talking about. I never had dreams of an actual mall or the ability to explore anything, but some aspects of those dreams felt really familiar to me and I can't let it go. I had a lot of dreams as a child we're I was really lucid, but they always felt like dreams, but some (only a few) we're different and I could never explain why. I had a few dreams that where not like anything I know from real life, which I know is not that strange per se, but what stuck was that these dreams never felt like a dream. I knew those places and the people in them very well. For what I remember the places where more in a jungle environment and around small villages and there didn't seem to be any noticable technology, but a lot of it is really vague now. The thing that stuck with me the most is that I had these dreams as a child, and forgot about those places, but around 15 years later I was there again and I immediately recognized the place from my childhood dreams which I had long and completely forgotten about. Somehow, I don't know why, but I'm not able to keep the details in mind and they just some vague images and mainly the feeling and what I was thinking at the moment of those dreams stays. I'm very curious if someone here has similar experiences or recognizes something of what I'm talking about.
